# Qevon

> Software engineering studio. We design, engineer and deploy software and
> the infrastructure it runs on. Founded 2026. No sales team — you talk
> directly to the people building it.

## Pages

- [Home](https://qevon.vercel.app/): Overview of Qevon and its capabilities.
- [Work](https://qevon.vercel.app/work): Every shipped project, with real, sourced results.
- [Services](https://qevon.vercel.app/services): Software engineering, web & product, cloud & DevOps, AI & ML systems, security, data & analytics, legacy modernisation.
- [About](https://qevon.vercel.app/about): Who Qevon is and how the studio works.
- [Contact](https://qevon.vercel.app/contact): Start a project.

## Projects

- [Grand Motel OS](https://qevon.vercel.app/work/grandmotel-os): Point of sale, inventory and customers in one system — stock moves as orders do, and the day reconciles itself.
- [SentinelOps](https://qevon.vercel.app/work/sentinelops): Point it at a repo. It runs 29 checks across 6 categories and scores production-readiness out of 100.
- [Bingus](https://qevon.vercel.app/work/bingus): A location-based social platform — posts and connections anchored to real places.
- [Phishing URL Detection](https://qevon.vercel.app/work/phishing-url-detection): A hybrid LSTM + CNN model that classifies URLs as phishing or legitimate from 90 engineered features.
